10 REM  LEVEL MAKER
20 ML = 2:D$ =  CHR$ (4)
30 FOR LV = 1 TO ML
40 PRINT D$;"OPEN LV";LV
50 PRINT D$;"WRITE LV";LV
60 FOR Y = 1 TO 10: READ A$: PRINT A$: NEXT Y
70 PRINT D$;"CLOSE LV";LV
80 NEXT LV
